page.overview:
What is Beakkal?

was a jungle world during the time of the Great Spice War and the site of a war memorial on the Senasar plateau

Around 10175 AG, the troops of House Atreides and House Vernius made a desperate last stand against the Sardaukar armies, the protectors of the Imperial House Corrino.

The Swordmaster Duncan Idaho led the Atreides soldiers alongside their allies strike to destroy the archeological digs, thwarting the Tleilaxu yet again.
